title: Fox dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- tail -->
    <path d='M70 72 Q88 70 90 52 Q92 36 82 30 Q86 44 78 54 Q72 62 66 64 Z' fill='#FF8A3D' stroke='#FFC08A' stroke-width='2'/>
    <path d='M89 50 Q90 38 83 33 Q86 44 79 53 Z' fill='#FFF4E0'/>
    <!-- back leg -->
    <path d='M60 78 Q56 88 58 92 L68 92 Q68 86 66 78 Z' fill='#D9691C'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='56' cy='64' rx='18' ry='17' fill='#FF8A3D' stroke='#FFC08A' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- chest -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#FFF4E0'/>
    <!-- front leg raised (dancing) -->
    <path d='M40 62 Q30 54 26 44 L31 40 Q37 50 44 56 Z' fill='#FF8A3D' stroke='#FFC08A' stroke-width='2'/>
    <circle cx='27' cy='42' r='4' fill='#FFF4E0'/>
    <!-- other front leg -->
    <path d='M44 76 Q42 86 44 91 L54 91 Q52 84 52 76 Z' fill='#D9691C'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='36' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#FF8A3D' stroke='#FFC08A' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <path d='M26 26 L22 8 L36 20 Z' fill='#FF8A3D' stroke='#FFC08A' stroke-width='2'/>
    <path d='M27 24 L24 13 L33 21 Z' fill='#3B2314'/>
    <path d='M48 24 L56 8 L58 22 Z' fill='#FF8A3D' stroke='#FFC08A' stroke-width='2'/>
    <path d='M49 22 L54 13 L55 21 Z' fill='#3B2314'/>
    <!-- cheek/muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx='32' cy='42' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#FFF4E0'/>
    <!-- snout -->
    <path d='M22 40 Q30 36 34 42 Q30 46 24 44 Z' fill='#FFD24A'/>
    <ellipse cx='26' cy='40' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#FFF4E0'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <ellipse cx='40' cy='34' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2B1B4A'/>
    <circle cx='41' cy='33' r='1' fill='#FFF4E0'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#2B1B4A'/>
    <circle cx='50.7' cy='31' r='0.9' fill='#FFF4E0'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M30 46 Q35 50 40 46' fill='none' stroke='#D9691C' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- music notes for dancing -->
    <path d='M74 24 L74 14 L80 16 L80 24' fill='none' stroke='#7BE0FF' stroke-width='2'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='25' r='2.5' fill='#7BE0FF'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='25' r='2.5' fill='#7BE0FF'/>
    <path d='M62 18 L62 10' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='2'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='19' r='2.2' fill='#FFE066'/>
  </g>
</svg>
